root_cause: Powerhouse had posting, relationship scoring, public research and isolated comment capability, but they were not orchestrated as one revenue sequence. Direct-message capability was also being conceptually treated as if it might exist despite no supported provider action being available.
decision: Create one LinkedIn sales machine that turns fresh company-specific posts into bounded value-add comments, converts inbound LinkedIn engagement into intent evidence, feeds anonymized trigger clusters into company-page content, and coordinates private email follow-up after a LinkedIn touch.
prevention: Never claim or simulate LinkedIn DM unless a verified provider send-DM tool exists.
A public comment requires a concrete LinkedIn post URL plus company-specific evidence, relationship score >= 0.55 and trigger confidence >= 0.60.
Cap autonomous comments at 3/day and one/person/14d; comments contain insight, not a sales pitch.
Sales air cover is published from the company page using anonymized trigger clusters; personal LinkedIn post identity rules remain unchanged.
When a contextual LinkedIn comment exists, wait 24 hours before direct email to the same person.
All outcomes feed the existing Powerhouse action/outcome/learning lineage.
